sourceReferences.description: Standalone gold pen/drop symbol on dark background.
Gold symbol plus dark ARTales wordmark on warm paper background.
Gold symbol plus gold ARTales wordmark on dark background.

primarySymbol.notes: The symbol should be the primary standalone mark. It reads as a pen nib up close and as a gold drop from distance, which is useful for animation and small identity uses.

primaryLogo.decision: symbol on the left plus ARTales wordmark on the right
primaryLogo.notes: This is the preferred full logo lockup for official and web use.

darkVariant.decision: gold symbol and gold wordmark on dark background
darkVariant.notes: Dark presentation should support the calm cultural/gallery tone.

lightVariant.decision: gold symbol and dark wordmark on warm paper background
lightVariant.notes: Light presentation should feel editorial, paper-like and readable.

monogram.decision: reserve candidate, not the primary mark
monogram.notes: The monogram can remain available for internal, secondary or fallback use, but the pen/drop symbol should lead.

texture.decision: presentation layer, not the production master
texture.notes: Texture may be used in mockups, marketing and presentation assets. Locked masters must also exist as clean, reproducible vector/flat assets.

primarySymbol.description: Vertical, symmetrical gold pen/drop mark with a central diamond detail and small lower drop endpoint.

primaryLogoLockup.description: Horizontal logo lockup with the pen/drop symbol on the left and ARTales wordmark on the right.

wordmark.description: Elegant literary serif wordmark reading ARTales, with dominant ART and softer lowercase ales.
wordmark.typographicDirection: high-contrast literary serif with editorial/cultural character

monogram.description: Secondary candidate only. It should not replace the pen/drop symbol as the primary mark at this stage.

candidatePalette.notes: Values are extracted from raster references and should be confirmed before becoming design tokens.

colors.name: Text Dark
colors.role: dark wordmark or text on light background

colors.name: Gold Shade
colors.role: support gold shade for presentation texture

rules: Gold should be an accent, not a broad decorative surface.
Use fewer core color tokens for the first implementation; derived shades can be added later.
Contrast checks are required before runtime use.

variantPrinciples.notes: Dark and light variants should be color/use variants of the same underlying logo and symbol geometry, not separate identities.

textureAndMateriality.description: The references show paper/material texture and gold depth. This is suitable for presentation and marketing, but must not be the only production master form.
textureAndMateriality.rule: Locked masters must also exist as clean vector/flat assets. Texture can be generated or exported as a presentation layer.

nextRecommendedSteps: Prepare or obtain clean SVG/vector masters for the primary symbol and primary logo lockup.
Confirm whether the wordmark is font-based or custom lettering, including license status if relevant.
Confirm final core color tokens after testing against light and dark UI surfaces.
Define export profiles before generating production assets.
Create a brand sheet after vector masters and candidate tokens are ready.
